description:
First device-test release for Reddit 2026.14.0.

- Hides interactive Reddit App posts.
- Adds an NSFW-only bottom bar mode. Toggling it saves and restores the existing Show NSFW and Blur NSFW settings.
- Works alongside Morphe's built-in Reddit patches. In Expert mode, enable patches from both sources.

The new button uses Reddit's Games icon with an NSFW label. The patch applies successfully with the default upstream Reddit patches, but the UI and settings behavior still need on-device verification.
